draft_en.subject: Alongside ICP DAS and D-Link in your automation panels - a budget industrial line
draft_en.body:
Hello TOP-FA team,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 15 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the ICP DAS and D-Link networking you list for automation panels, a budget industrial line, neutral-brand, at distributor price, EXW, from single pieces, 15-day validity, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 5 x Gigabit unmanaged - model STI-050GE - $17.0 USD; 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-280GE - $46; 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-288GP - $60. Serial gateways stay with ICP DAS - we do not do them. KC stays on your side.

One question: which port count do your automation customers buy most - 5 or 8?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
